text: A laboratory bench against a pale wall. At left, a white balance or scale with a blue-and-white display panel and colored keypad buttons sits on a white platform; a dark cable runs from it, and a black cable descends the wall above. Center: a raised white shelf supported by two grey/silver vertical posts, holding a horizontal black rack with several dark round holders and a white boxy unit with a grey top panel. Below the shelf sits a dark grey rectangular block on a white base, with a black-and-white square fiducial marker on the front face. At right, a vertical aluminum rail with bolt heads, a magenta panel with a marker at top, and a blue/white instrument with small metal cylinders behind.
